title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초1 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 165 ]

blocks.text: Because of the slow rise in obesity in Korea today, many Koreans are becoming more interested in their health and try to exercise regularly in order to stay in shape.
Some people go to health clubs, attend exercise classes, mountain climb, or swim.
When we are active, we stay healthier.
When we are healthier, we can live longer and happier lives.
